title_en: Interpretation (I) of the Supreme People's Court on Issues concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Labor Dispute Cases

articles.content_en:
Article 3 A labor dispute case shall be under the jurisdiction of the Primary People's Court of the place where the employer is located or where the labor contract is performed.
If the place where the labor contract is performed is unclear, jurisdiction shall lie with the Primary People's Court of the place where the employer is located.
Where laws provide otherwise, those provisions shall apply.

Article 4 Where both a劳动者 and an employer refuse to accept the same ruling of a labor dispute arbitration institution and initiate prosecutions in the same People's Court, the People's Court shall hear the cases jointly. The two parties shall be the plaintiff and the defendant of each other, and the People's Court shall render a ruling on the claims of both parties together. In the course of the action, if one party withdraws the prosecution, the People's Court shall continue the trial based on the claim of the other party. If the two parties initiate prosecutions in different People's Courts with jurisdiction over the same arbitration ruling, the People's Court that later accepts the case shall transfer the case to the People's Court that first accepted it.

Article 7 Where a labor dispute arbitration institution makes a written ruling, decision or notice of non-acceptance on the ground that the applicant is not a proper subject for arbitration, and a party refuses to accept it and initiates a prosecution according to law, if upon examination it is confirmed that the subject is indeed not proper, the People's Court shall not accept the case; if it has already been accepted, it shall render a ruling to dismiss the prosecution.

Article 8 Where a labor dispute arbitration institution makes a new ruling to correct an error in the original arbitration ruling, and a party refuses to accept it and initiates a prosecution according to law, the People's Court shall accept the case.

Article 9 Where a matter arbitrated by a labor dispute arbitration institution does not fall within the scope of cases accepted by the People's Court, and a party refuses to accept it and initiates a prosecution according to law, the People's Court shall not accept the case; if it has already been accepted, it shall render a ruling to dismiss the prosecution.

Article 10 Where a party refuses to accept a ruling made by a labor dispute arbitration institution on advance payment of labor remuneration, work-related injury medical expenses, economic compensation or damages to a劳动者, and initiates a prosecution according to law, the People's Court shall not accept the case.
If the employer fails to perform the payment obligation under the aforesaid ruling, and the劳动者 applies for compulsory execution according to law, the People's Court shall accept the application.

Article 11 Where a mediation document made by a labor dispute arbitration institution has already taken legal effect, and one party reneges and initiates a prosecution, the People's Court shall not accept the case; if it has already been accepted, it shall render a ruling to dismiss the prosecution.

Article 13 Where a劳动者 applies to the People's Court for an order for payment pursuant to Article 30, Paragraph 2 of the Labor Contract Law and Article 16 of the Mediation and Arbitration Law, and the application meets the requirements of the supervision procedure under Chapter 17 of the Civil Procedure Law, the People's Court shall accept the application.
After the People's Court renders a ruling terminating the supervision procedure for an application for an order for payment under Article 30, Paragraph 2 of the Labor Contract Law, if the劳动者 directly initiates a prosecution on the labor dispute matter, the People's Court shall inform him/her to first apply for arbitration with the labor dispute arbitration institution.
After the People's Court renders a ruling terminating the supervision procedure for an application for an order for payment under Article 16 of the Mediation and Arbitration Law, if the劳动者 directly initiates a prosecution based on the mediation agreement, the People's Court shall accept the case.

Article 14 After the People's Court accepts a labor dispute case, if a party adds a claim, where such claim is inseparable from the labor dispute in dispute, it shall be heard jointly; if it is an independent labor dispute, the party shall be informed to apply for arbitration with the labor dispute arbitration institution.

Article 15 Where a劳动者 directly initiates a prosecution using the employer's wage IOU as evidence, and the claim does not involve other disputes over the labor relationship, it shall be deemed a dispute over arrears of labor remuneration, and the People's Court shall accept it as an ordinary civil dispute.

Article 16 After a labor dispute arbitration institution makes an arbitration ruling, if a party refuses to accept part of the matters in the ruling and initiates a prosecution according to law, the labor dispute arbitration ruling shall not take legal effect.

Article 17 After a labor dispute arbitration institution makes an arbitration ruling on a labor dispute involving multiple劳动者, if some劳动者 refuse to accept the arbitration ruling and initiate a prosecution according to law, the arbitration ruling shall not take legal effect for the劳动者 who initiated the prosecution; it shall take legal effect for the部分劳动者 who did not initiate the prosecution. If they apply for enforcement, the People's Court shall accept the application.

Article 19 If the arbitration ruling document does not indicate whether the ruling is a final ruling or a non-final ruling, and a劳动者, pursuant to Article 47, Item (1) of the Mediation and Arbitration Law, claims labor remuneration, work-related injury medical expenses, economic compensation or damages, and if the arbitration ruling involves several items, each of which does not exceed the amount equivalent to 12 months of the local monthly minimum wage standard, the ruling shall be treated as a final ruling.

Article 20 If the same arbitration ruling made by a labor dispute arbitration institution contains both final ruling matters and non-final ruling matters, and a party refuses to accept the arbitration ruling and initiates a prosecution in the People's Court, the ruling shall be treated as a non-final ruling.

Article 21 Where a劳动者 initiates a prosecution in the Primary People's Court pursuant to Article 48 of the Mediation and Arbitration Law, and the employer applies to the Intermediate People's Court of the place where the labor dispute arbitration institution is located for revocation of the arbitration ruling pursuant to Article 49 of the Mediation and Arbitration Law, the Intermediate People's Court shall not accept the application; if it has already accepted it, it shall render a ruling to dismiss the application.
If the prosecution is dismissed by the People's Court or the劳动者 withdraws the prosecution, the employer may apply to the Intermediate People's Court of the place where the labor dispute arbitration institution is located for revocation of the arbitration ruling within 30 days from the date of receipt of the ruling.

Article 22 Where an employer applies to the Intermediate People's Court for revocation of an arbitration ruling pursuant to Article 49 of the Mediation and Arbitration Law, the Intermediate People's Court's ruling to dismiss the application or revoke the arbitration ruling shall be a final ruling.

Article 23 When the Intermediate People's Court hears a case where an employer applies for revocation of a final ruling, it shall form a collegial panel and hold a hearing. After reviewing the case files, conducting investigations, and questioning the parties, if the collegial panel finds that there are no new facts, evidence or reasons and deems that a hearing is unnecessary, it may proceed without a hearing.
The Intermediate People's Court may organize mediation between the parties. If a mediation agreement is reached, a mediation document may be prepared. If one party fails to perform the mediation agreement within the time limit, the other party may apply to the People's Court for compulsory enforcement.

Article 25 Where a labor dispute arbitration institution makes a final ruling, the劳动者 applies to the People's Court for enforcement, and the employer applies to the Intermediate People's Court of the place where the labor dispute arbitration institution is located for revocation, the People's Court shall render a ruling to suspend enforcement.
If the employer withdraws the application for revocation of the final ruling or the application is dismissed, the People's Court shall render a ruling to resume enforcement. If the arbitration ruling is revoked, the People's Court shall render a ruling to terminate enforcement.
If the employer's application to the People's Court for revocation of the arbitration ruling is dismissed, and the employer later raises an objection to enforcement based on the same grounds in the enforcement proceedings, the People's Court shall not support such objection.

Article 26 Where an employer merges with another entity, the entity resulting from the merger shall be the party to labor disputes arising before the merger; where an employer is divided into several entities, the actual employer after the division shall be the party to labor disputes arising before the division.
If, after the division of an employer into several entities, the entity that specifically assumes the labor rights and obligations is unclear, all entities after the division shall be parties.

Article 27 Where an employer recruits a劳动者 who has not yet dissolved his/her labor contract, and a labor dispute arises between the original employer and the劳动者, the new employer may be listed as a third party.
If the original employer initiates a prosecution on the ground that the new employer has infringed upon its rights, the劳动者 may be listed as a third party.
If the original employer initiates a prosecution on the ground that the new employer and the劳动者 have jointly infringed upon its rights, the new employer and the劳动者 shall be listed as co-defendants.

Article 28 Where, during a period of contractual operation between an employer and another equal entity, a劳动者 and either or both of the contracting party and the party awarding the contract have a labor dispute, and a prosecution is initiated according to law, the contracting party and the party awarding the contract shall be listed as parties.

Article 29 Where a劳动者 has a dispute with an employer that has not obtained a business license, or whose business license has been revoked, or that continues to operate after the expiration of its business term, the employer or its investor shall be listed as a party.

Article 30 Where an employer that has not obtained a business license, or whose business license has been revoked, or that continues to operate after the expiration of its business term, operates by borrowing another entity's business license through affiliation or other means, the employer and the entity that lent the business license shall be listed as parties.

Article 31 Where a party refuses to accept an arbitration ruling made by a labor dispute arbitration institution and initiates a prosecution according to law, and upon examination the People's Court finds that the arbitration ruling omitted a person who must participate in the arbitration jointly, the omitted person shall be added as a party to the action according to law.
If the added party shall bear liability, the People's Court shall handle the matter together.

Article 32 Where an employer initiates a prosecution due to a dispute over employment with a person who has lawfully enjoyed pension insurance benefits or receives a retirement pension, the People's Court shall handle the matter as a labor service relationship.
Where a person who has retained his/her position without pay (停薪留职人员), an early retiree who has not reached the statutory retirement age (内退人员), a laid-off worker awaiting reemployment (下岗待岗人员), or a person on long-term leave due to the employer's operational suspension (企业经营性停产放长假人员) initiates a prosecution due to a dispute over employment with a new employer, the People's Court shall handle the matter as a labor relationship.

Article 33 Where a foreigner or stateless person who has not lawfully obtained an employment certificate concludes a labor contract with an employer within the territory of the People's Republic of China, and a party requests confirmation of a labor relationship with the employer, the People's Court shall not support the request.
If a foreigner who holds a Foreign Expert Certificate and has obtained a Foreigner's Work Permit in China establishes an employment relationship with an employer within the territory of the People's Republic of China, it may be recognized as a labor relationship.

Article 34 After the expiration of a labor contract, if the劳动者 continues to work for the original employer and the original employer does not raise any objection, it shall be deemed that both parties agree to continue performing the labor contract on the original terms. If one party proposes to terminate the labor relationship, the People's Court shall support it.
Where, pursuant to Article 14 of the Labor Contract Law, the employer shall conclude an open-ended labor contract with the劳动者 but fails to do so, the People's Court may deem that an open-ended labor contract relationship exists between the parties, and the rights and obligations of the parties shall be determined based on the original labor contract.

Article 35 An agreement reached between a劳动者 and an employer regarding the handling of relevant procedures for dissolution or termination of a labor contract, payment of wages, overtime pay, economic compensation or damages, etc., shall be deemed valid if it does not violate mandatory provisions of laws or administrative regulations, and there is no fraud, coercion, or exploitation of the other party's distress.
If the agreement referred to in the preceding paragraph contains a material mistake or is manifestly unfair, and a party requests its revocation, the People's Court shall support the request.

Article 36 Where the parties have agreed on non-competition in a labor contract or confidentiality agreement, but have not agreed to provide economic compensation to the劳动者 after the dissolution or termination of the labor contract, and the劳动者 has fulfilled the non-competition obligation, if the劳动者 requests the employer to pay monthly economic compensation at 30% of the劳动者's average monthly wage for the 12 months preceding the dissolution or termination of the labor contract, the People's Court shall support the request.
If 30% of the average monthly wage as specified in the preceding paragraph is lower than the minimum wage standard of the place where the labor contract is performed, the payment shall be made according to the minimum wage standard of the place where the labor contract is performed.

Article 37 Where the parties have agreed on non-competition and economic compensation in a labor contract or confidentiality agreement, and the parties dissolve the labor contract, unless otherwise agreed, if the employer requests the劳动者 to fulfill the non-competition obligation, or the劳动者, after fulfilling the non-competition obligation, requests the employer to pay economic compensation, the People's Court shall support the request.

Article 38 Where the parties have agreed on non-competition and economic compensation in a labor contract or confidentiality agreement, and after the dissolution or termination of the labor contract, due to reasons attributable to the employer, the economic compensation has not been paid for three months, and the劳动者 requests to rescind the non-competition agreement, the People's Court shall support the request.

Article 39 During the non-competition period, if the employer requests to rescind the non-competition agreement, the People's Court shall support the request.
If, upon rescission of the non-competition agreement, the劳动者 requests the employer to pay an additional three months of economic compensation for non-competition, the People's Court shall support the request.

Article 40 Where a劳动者 violates a non-competition agreement and pays liquidated damages to the employer, and the employer requests the劳动者 to continue fulfilling the non-competition obligation according to the agreement, the People's Court shall support the request.

Article 41 Where a labor contract is confirmed to be void but the劳动者 has already performed labor, the employer shall pay labor remuneration and economic compensation to the劳动者 in accordance with Articles 28, 46 and 47 of the Labor Contract Law.
If the void labor contract is concluded due to reasons attributable to the employer, causing losses to the劳动者, the employer shall compensate the劳动者 for the economic losses caused by the void contract.

Article 42 Where a劳动者 claims overtime pay, he/she shall bear the burden of adducing evidence for the existence of overtime work. However, if the劳动者 has evidence proving that the employer possesses evidence of the existence of overtime work and the employer fails to provide it, the employer shall bear the adverse consequences.

Article 43 Where an employer and a劳动者 have agreed to modify the labor contract through consultation, and although the modification was not made in writing, the orally modified labor contract has been actually performed for more than one month, and the content of the modified labor contract does not violate laws or administrative regulations and does not contravene public order and good customs, if a party claims that the modification of the labor contract is void on the ground that it was not made in writing, the People's Court shall not support the claim.

Article 44 For labor disputes arising from decisions made by the employer such as dismissal, removal, expulsion, termination of labor contract, reduction of labor remuneration, calculation of the劳动者's length of service, etc., the employer shall bear the burden of adducing evidence.

Article 47 Where an employer that has established a trade union dissolves a labor contract in compliance with Articles 39 and 40 of the Labor Contract Law, but fails to notify the trade union in advance as required by Article 43 of the Labor Contract Law, and the劳动者 requests the employer to pay damages on the ground that the employer illegally dissolved the labor contract, the People's Court shall support the request, except where the employer has remedied the relevant procedures before the prosecution.

Article 48 After the Labor Contract Law takes effect, if the labor contract cannot continue to be performed because the employer's business term has expired and it no longer continues operations, and the劳动者 requests the employer to pay economic compensation, the People's Court shall support the request.

Article 49 In the course of litigation, if a劳动者 applies to the People's Court for adoption of property preservation measures, and upon examination the People's Court finds that the applicant is genuinely in financial difficulty or there is evidence proving that the employer may abscond with wages, the People's Court shall reduce or exempt the劳动者 from providing a guarantee and shall promptly adopt preservation measures.
In the property preservation ruling, the People's Court shall inform the parties that they shall apply for compulsory enforcement within three months after the ruling document of the labor dispute arbitration institution or the judgment document of the People's Court takes effect. If no application is made within the time limit, the People's Court shall render a ruling to lift the preservation measures.

Article 50 Internal rules and regulations formulated by an employer through democratic procedures pursuant to Article 4 of the Labor Contract Law, which do not violate national laws, administrative regulations, or policies, and have been disclosed to the劳动者, may serve as the basis for determining the rights and obligations of both parties.
If the internal rules and regulations formulated by the employer are inconsistent with the content agreed in the collective contract or labor contract, and the劳动者 requests that the contract provisions be applied preferentially, the People's Court shall support the request.

Article 51 A mediation agreement that contains the content of labor rights and obligations reached by the parties under the auspices of a mediation organization as prescribed in Article 10 of the Mediation and Arbitration Law shall have the binding force of a labor contract and may serve as the basis for the judgment of a People's Court.
Where the parties reach a mediation agreement only on a labor remuneration dispute under the auspices of a mediation organization as prescribed in Article 10 of the Mediation and Arbitration Law, and the employer fails to perform the payment obligations determined in the mediation agreement, and the worker directly initiates a prosecution, the People's Court may accept the case as an ordinary civil dispute.

Article 52 Where the parties reach a mediation agreement only on payment obligations under the auspices of a People's Mediation Committee, and both parties consider it necessary, they may jointly apply to the Primary People's Court in the locality of the People's Mediation Committee for judicial confirmation.

Article 53 Where the employer's decision to discharge, remove, dismiss, or otherwise terminate a labor contract for other reasons is indeed erroneous, the People's Court may, according to law, render a judgment to revoke such decision.
For cases involving the recovery of labor remuneration, pension, medical expenses, work-related injury insurance benefits, economic compensation, training fees, and other related expenses, if the amount of payment is improper, the People's Court may modify it.
Article 54 This Interpretation shall come into force on January 1, 2021.
